source_texts:
Jesus Calls His First Disciples
1 One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret,[a] the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God. 2 He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets. 3 He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.

4 When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”

1 Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”

6 When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break. 7 So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.

8 When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, “Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!” 9 For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken, 10 and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners.

Then Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid; from now on you will fish for people.” 11 So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.

Jesus Heals a Man With Leprosy
12 While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy.[b] When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, “Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean.”

13 Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.

14 Then Jesus ordered him, “Don’t tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”

15 Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses. 16 But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.

Jesus Forgives and Heals a Paralyzed Man
17 One day Jesus was teaching, and Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. They had come from every village of Galilee and from Judea and Jerusalem. And the power of the Lord was with Jesus to heal the sick. 18 Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus. 19 When they could not find a way to do this because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.

20 When Jesus saw their faith, he said, “Friend, your sins are forgiven.”

21 The Pharisees and the teachers of the law began thinking to themselves, “Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

22 Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts? 23 Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’? 24 But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.” So he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.” 25 Immediately he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising God. 26 Everyone was amazed and gave praise to God. They were filled with awe and said, “We have seen remarkable things today.”

Jesus Calls Levi and Eats With Sinners
27 After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth. “Follow me,” Jesus said to him, 28 and Levi got up, left everything and followed him.

29 Then Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them. 30 But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect complained to his disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?”

31 Jesus answered them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. 32 I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

Jesus Questioned About Fasting
33 They said to him, “John’s disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking.”

34 Jesus answered, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? 35 But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast.”

36 He told them this parable: “No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one. Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old. 37 And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined. 38 No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins. 39 And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for they say, ‘The old is better.’”
translations:
耶稣召唤他的第一门门徒
1 有一天,耶稣站在日拿撒湖边,众人聚集在他身边,倾听神的话. 2 他看见两艘船在水边,渔民离开了,正在洗网. 3 耶稣上了那一艘船,是西门的,请他从岸上稍微拉下去.他就坐在船上,从船上开始教导众人.

4 讲完话,耶稣对西门说: "把子到深海,把网子投下去,捕鱼.

1 西门回答说: "师父啊,我们一夜都劳碌,却没有鱼;但是因你的话,我将网子投下.

6 他们这样做,就捕了许多鱼,他们的网就破裂了. 7 他们就招呼那船上的同伴来帮助他们.他们来,把两艘船都满了,到底淹没了.

8 西门彼得看见这事,就跪在耶稣面前说:主阿,离开我,因为我是罪人. 9 因为他和他的同伴们都因他们捕鱼的惊, 10 撒伯底的儿子雅各和约翰,西门的同事也这样.耶稣对西门说:不要害怕,从此你必捕人. 11 他们把船到岸边,就离开了一切,跟随了耶稣.耶稣医治了一个疾人,
12 耶稣在那一座城里,有一个满满的男人来到那里.他看见耶稣,俯伏在地上,求耶稣说:"主啊,如果你愿意,你能使我洁净.

13 耶稣伸手摸他,说: 我愿意.你就洁净了.马上,他就从病中消失了.

14 耶稣吩咐他说: 不要告诉任何人,但你去向祭司展示自己,献摩西所吩咐的洁净祭,为他们见证.

15 然而,他的名声越来越传出去,众人都来听他,被治愈他们的病. 16 耶稣却往往往旷野去祷告.他赦免了一个的,治好了一个的人.
17 有一天,耶稣教训,法利赛人和律法师都坐在那里.他们从加利利,犹大,耶路撒冷各村庄来了.主的能力在他身上,使病人治愈. 18 有些人带着一个子在床上,试图把他带进房子,将他放在耶稣面前. 19 因为众人多,他们不能办法,就上屋顶,把他倒在床上,把他倒在人中间,在耶稣面前.

20 耶稣看见他们的信心,就说:"朋友,你的罪赦免了".

21 法利赛人和律法学家就想着自己说:这亵神的人是谁呢?只有神才能赦免罪呢?

22 耶稣知道他们的心思,就说:你们为什么心里这样想呢? 23 哪个比说:' 你的罪原谅了',容易呢?还是说:' 起来行吧'呢? 24 但要你们知道,人子在地上有权赦罪.他对子说:我告诉你,起来,拿你的,回家吧. 25 他立刻站在他们面前,拿起床上躺的,回家,荣耀上帝. 26 众人都惊,赞美神,敬畏,说:我们今天看见了奇事.耶稣叫利未和罪人一同吃饭.
27 之后,耶稣出去,看见一个叫利未的税吏坐在税上.耶稣对他说: 28 利未起来,一切都离开,跟随耶稣.

29 利未在家里给耶稣举了一个盛宴,有许多税吏和其他人与他们同席. 30 法利赛人和他们的律法师对门徒抱怨说:你们为什么和税吏和罪人一同吃喝呢?

31 耶稣回答说: 没有健康的人需要医生,而是病人需要医生. 32 我来不是叫义人悔改,而叫罪人悔改.
33 他们说:约翰的门徒常禁食,祷告,法利赛人的门徒也这样,但你的门徒常吃喝.

34 耶稣说: 婚夫与他们同在的时候,你们能叫新郎的朋友禁食吗? 35 但有一天,新郎将被从他们那里夺去,那时他们就会禁食.

36 他又对他们说了这比喻: 没有人撕裂新衣服的块,将旧衣服起来.不然,新衣服就撕裂了,新衣服的也不和旧衣服一样. 37 没有人把新酒倒在旧的子里,否则新酒会撕裂子,酒就流尽,子就坏了. 38 不,新酒要倒在新子里. 39 喝过旧酒后,也没有人想要新酒,因为他们说:"旧酒更好. "
